entries.title: Air holes turn silicon wafers into flat ultraviolet focusing mirrors for compact optics
entries.summary: Traditional lenses and mirrors focus light using curved surfaces. Metasurfaces can achieve similar functions with a flat layer of nanoscale structures that locally control the phase of light. Extending these flat optics into the ultraviolet could support compact systems for…
